data.name: Molana
data.gender_notes: Molana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Molana is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mohini' which means 'Goddess of Knowledge'. She is also known as the 'Enchantress of the Gods', as she has the power to enchant and captivate even the most powerful beings. The name Molana carries the meaning “Goddess of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Molana usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Molana represents the divine feminine energy of knowledge and wisdom. She is a symbol of enlightenment and is believed to bestow her blessings upon those who seek knowledge and truth.
data.etymology: Molana belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Molana total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
